rationale: The agent did authenticate the user (looked up user by name/ZIP and fetched user details) and retrieved order/product details, and even computed savings. However, it proceeded to execute order-changing writes (return_delivered_order_items and exchange_delivered_order_items) without explicitly confirming with the user beforehand. The policy requires confirmation before any order-changing action. Additionally, the agent did not clearly present the savings for both options to the user and confirm which path to take, nor provide a proper final summary; the only closing line is a generic sign-off. These issues violate the pass bar, so the conversation fails.
